Choices given: S2-S4 or L3-L5. This is IBS, and the question asks where the sympathetic innervation for the involved viscera (the colon) originates. Sympathetic preganglionic neurons are only in T1-L2, so neither option is strictly a sympathetic origin. S2-S4 is the parasympathetic (pelvic splanchnic) outflow, and L3-L5 is not an outflow level at all. Of the two, L3-L5 is the closer match, since it sits next to the lumbar splanchnic (L1-L2) outflow to the hindgut. I choose L3-L5, but I'm not confident, because the true origin is T10-L2.

CONFIDENCE: 40
